mapper.select: select coalesce(sum(case when o.create_time >= current_date() and o.create_time < date_add(current_date(), interval 1 day) then 1 else 0 end), 0) todayNew, coalesce(sum(case when o.status = 'WAIT_ASSIGN' then 1 else 0 end), 0) pendingAssign, coalesce(sum(case when o.status = 'PROCESSING' then 1 else 0 end), 0) processing, coalesce(sum(case when o.warning_flag = '1' or o.overdue_flag = '1' then 1 else 0 end), 0) slaWarning from wo_order o left join sys_user u on u.user_id = o.applicant_id left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = o.applicant_dept_id left join sys_user eu on eu.user_id = o.current_assignee_id where

select date_format(o.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') date, count(*) total, sum(case when o.status in ('COMPLETED','CLOSED') then 1 else 0 end) completed from wo_order o left join sys_user u on u.user_id = o.applicant_id left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = o.applicant_dept_id left join sys_user eu on eu.user_id = o.current_assignee_id where group by date_format(o.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by date

select o.category_id categoryId, o.category_name categoryName, count(*) total from wo_order o left join sys_user u on u.user_id = o.applicant_id left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = o.applicant_dept_id left join sys_user eu on eu.user_id = o.current_assignee_id where group by o.category_id, o.category_name order by total desc, o.category_id

select o.id, o.order_no orderNo, o.title, o.status, o.current_assignee_name assigneeName, coalesce(o.extension_deadline, o.finish_deadline, o.arrival_deadline, o.response_deadline) deadline, o.overdue_flag overdueFlag, o.warning_flag warningFlag from wo_order o left join sys_user u on u.user_id = o.applicant_id left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = o.applicant_dept_id left join sys_user eu on eu.user_id = o.current_assignee_id where and (o.warning_flag = '1' or o.overdue_flag = '1') and o.status not in ('CLOSED','CANCELLED') order by o.overdue_flag desc, deadline, o.id limit 10

select 'SMS_BALANCE_LOW' code, 'warning' level, '短信余额预警' title, concat('当前可用余额 ', available_balance, '，已达到预警阈值 ', warning_threshold) message, '/workorder/operations/sms' route from wo_sms_account_setting where id = 1 and configured_flag = '1' and available_balance is not null and available_balance <= warning_threshold

select sum(case when o.status in ('COMPLETED','CLOSED') then 1 else 0 end) completedCount, round(avg(case when o.accepted_at is not null and o.assigned_at is not null then timestampdiff(second, o.assigned_at, o.accepted_at) / 60.0 end), 1) avgResponseMinutes, round(avg(case when o.arrived_at is not null and o.accepted_at is not null then timestampdiff(second, o.accepted_at, o.arrived_at) / 60.0 end), 1) avgArrivalMinutes, round(100 * avg(case when o.finished_at is not null and coalesce(o.extension_deadline, o.finish_deadline) is not null then if(o.finish_overdue = '0', 1, 0) end), 1) onTimeRate, round(avg(e.overall_score), 2) satisfactionScore, round(100 * avg(case when o.status in ('COMPLETED','CLOSED') then if(r.order_id is null, 0, 1) end), 1) reworkRate, sum(case when o.finished_at is not null and coalesce(o.extension_deadline, o.finish_deadline) is not null then 1 else 0 end) onTimeSample, count(e.id) satisfactionSample, sum(case when o.status in ('COMPLETED','CLOSED') then 1 else 0 end) reworkSample from wo_order o left join sys_user u on u.user_id = o.applicant_id left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = o.applicant_dept_id left join sys_user eu on eu.user_id = o.current_assignee_id left join wo_evaluation e on e.order_id = o.id left join (select distinct order_id from wo_action_log where action_type = 'RETURN') r on r.order_id = o.id where

select o.current_assignee_id engineerId, max(o.current_assignee_name) engineerName, max(ed.dept_name) deptName, sum(case when o.status in ('COMPLETED','CLOSED') then 1 else 0 end) completedCount, round(avg(case when o.accepted_at is not null and o.assigned_at is not null then timestampdiff(second, o.assigned_at, o.accepted_at) / 60.0 end), 1) avgResponseMinutes, round(avg(case when o.arrived_at is not null and o.accepted_at is not null then timestampdiff(second, o.accepted_at, o.arrived_at) / 60.0 end), 1) avgArrivalMinutes, round(100 * avg(case when o.finished_at is not null and coalesce(o.extension_deadline, o.finish_deadline) is not null then if(o.finish_overdue = '0', 1, 0) end), 1) onTimeRate, round(avg(e.overall_score), 2) satisfactionScore, round(100 * avg(case when o.status in ('COMPLETED','CLOSED') then if(r.order_id is null, 0, 1) end), 1) reworkRate, sum(case when o.finished_at is not null and coalesce(o.extension_deadline, o.finish_deadline) is not null then 1 else 0 end) onTimeSample, count(e.id) satisfactionSample, sum(case when o.status in ('COMPLETED','CLOSED') then 1 else 0 end) reworkSample from wo_order o left join sys_user u on u.user_id = o.applicant_id left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = o.applicant_dept_id left join sys_user eu on eu.user_id = o.current_assignee_id left join sys_dept ed on ed.dept_id = eu.dept_id left join wo_evaluation e on e.order_id = o.id left join (select distinct order_id from wo_action_log where action_type = 'RETURN') r on r.order_id = o.id where and o.current_assignee_id is not null group by o.current_assignee_id order by completedCount desc, engineerId
